card.name: Linking words before a second named item
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (and, with, a comma, an opening parenthesis, to, the) that come right before the second item in a pair or list, such as a combination partner drug or a second breed or city.

modes.label: Drug combinations
modes.description: 'and' or 'with' linking a drug to its combination partner, such as a kinase inhibitor pair.
modes.example: The recommended dose is 450 mg orally once daily in combination<< with>> binimetinib.

modes.label: List or alternative entries
modes.description: A comma, 'and' or parenthesis introducing the next name in a list or an alternative.
modes.example: including Venice, Florence<<,>> and Milan, was formed.

modes.label: Animal study and section openers
modes.description: 'to' or 'the' just before the animal group or trial name in a toxicity or adverse-event passage.
